tagline: 佳能便携相机，1989 年发布
description: 佳能于1989年推出的便携相机。配备35mm f/4.5 (3 elements in 3 groups)。快门速度Electronic programmed shutter and aperture. Built-in electronic self-timer.。

specs.快门: Electronic programmed shutter and aperture. Built-in electronic self-timer.
specs.取景器: Reversed Galilean viewfinder with image-area frame. 0.42x magnification and 85% coverage.
specs.曝光测光: EV 10 (f/4.5 at 1/40 sec.) - EV 17 (f/32 at 1/125 sec.). Film speed range: ISO 50 - 1600 (with DX code).
specs.闪光灯: Fixed built-in flash. Guide no. 9. Fires automatically in low-light conditions.
specs.卷片: Automatic film advance (0.6 sec. per frame) and rewind.
specs.英文简介: An autofocus compact camera on a budget, the Snappy AF was released by Canon in 1989.
